card.title: Supportive Rage
card.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A supports B's birthday choice while each financial consequence sharpens the anger without ending help.
confusable: Unlike resentful refusal, A must continue making the desired outing happen through the fury.
comparison: D21-b follows an angry cost tally with arranging a window seat; D21-a follows ruined belongings with more cleanup help.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
